blocks.text: Blockchain records every hand-over in a supply chain on a decentralized ledger, so each step from raw-material supplier to final customer is traceable and cannot be altered. For a product such as chocolate, records are added as it passes from supplier to manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer and customer, and the customer can check the history to confirm the origin and quality.

blocks.alt: Six green tiles with icons around a circle, with arrows going clockwise: Supplier, Manufacturer, Fabricator, Intermediary, Retailer and Customer (End User-Consumer), and back to Supplier.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Tracking the origin of chocolate using blockchain (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 6.3).
